LUXEMBOURG , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Luxembourg House of Financial Technology (LHoFT) today announced that Finfra, an Indonesia-based lending-as-a-service platform and participant in its Catapult: Inclusion SE Asia program, is the ï¬rst company to receive investment through NextFin Asia.

The funding will support Finfra's growth, strengthen its technology platform, and support its expansion into new markets.
Launched in February 2026, NextFin Asia is the dedicated investment fund supporting LHoFT's Catapult: Inclusion SE Asia acceleration program.
